parameters.name: CheckId
parameters.description:
The ID of the check item.

> You can call the [ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~) operation to query the IDs of check items.

parameters.name: CustomConfigs
parameters.description: The custom configuration items of the check item.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The name of the custom configuration item. The name of a custom configuration item is unique in a check item.

sub_parameters.name: Operation
sub_parameters.description: The operation that you want to perform on the custom configuration item. This parameter is required only if you want to delete the custom configuration item. To delete the custom configuration item, set the value to DELETE.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the custom configuration item. The value is a string.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Security Center instance is deployed. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: International
*   **ap-southeast-1**: Singapore

parameters.name: RepairConfigs
parameters.description: The parameters required for fixing risk items.

sub_parameters.name: FlowId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the fixing process.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The name of the parameter required for fixing a risk item, which is unique in a check item.

sub_parameters.name: Operation
sub_parameters.description: The operation that you want to perform on the custom configuration item. This parameter is required only if you want to delete the custom configuration item. To delete the custom configuration item, set the value to DELETE.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the parameter required for fixing a risk item. The value is a string.
